ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80% high-intensity light grey pixels to 20% low-intensity black pixels across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity dark blob centered at the median notch, extending into both lobes. Right lobe contains multiple high-contrast dark focal spots and short bands. Left lobe is predominantly light-intensity with sparse dark mottling at the distal edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an internal angle of approximately 35 degrees; vertical depth is approximately 20% of the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations with low-amplitude peaks along the entire edge; high-amplitude clefts are visible on the right lobe distal to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the upper edge of the left lobe; right lobe sweep is interrupted by a deep vertical geometric break (split) creating a secondary tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of circular dark pixels on the right lobe mid-section; similar small clusters on the far left edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel vertical dark lines (rake marks) on the upper mid-section of the right lobe; isolated diagonal marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant deep vertical split near the right lobe tip, resulting in an asymmetrical trailing edge; rough-textured, high-contrast pixel clusters on the left tip indicative of barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: A non-cetacean silhouette (bird) is perched on the upper boundary of the left lobe approximately 1/3 of the distance from the tip to the notch.
